name: check-workflow
description: Check and fill missing workflow constraints, then submit a PR or MR without merging.

interface.shortDescription: Fill missing workflow rules and submit a PR or MR.
interface.longDescription: Check existing policies, add missing non-conflicting workflow constraints and agent entry references, validate, and submit a PR or MR without merging. Explicit check-only requests remain read-only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-check-workflow to check this repository, fill missing workflow rules and agent entry references without changing existing policies, validate, then commit, push, and open a PR or MR without merging.
